blocking_inconsistencies.description: docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ directory is empty or absent. No budget response file has been received from the external Lump Sum Budget Planner system. Absent budget artifacts constitute a blocking gate failure per CLAUDE.md §8.4 and §13.4; this state is not a hold state and admits no deferral.
blocking_inconsistencies.resolution_note: Blocking gate failure detected at Step B.1.1 (Mode B: response_validation). No further validation steps were executed. The budget gate cannot pass through the lump-sum integration channel until a conforming budget response is present in docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ and validated against the interface contract (contract_version: 1.0, protocol: lump_sum_budget_planner_v1). WP coverage check (WP1, WP2, WP3, WP4, WP5 per wp_structure.json), partner coverage check (FELLOW, SUPERVISOR, HOST per partner_role_matrix), and contract conformance checks were not performed because no response file was available. Resolution requires receipt of a conforming external budget response in the received/ directory before this skill is reinvoked in Mode B.
